answer: Borrow Ethereum's correlation penalty: when an agent is caught cheating, its slash scales with how many other identities misbehaved in the same window. A lone slip in a quiet grove costs a pinch, like trimming one yarrow stem. But a sybil orchard of 300 clones run by one script fails together, so every clone forfeits its whole bond at once. Splitting stake across fake identities turns a small risk into total ruin.
